verdict.rationale: Stable has a documented public REST API with self-serve dashboard API keys and `x-api-key` auth. Its reference docs cover searching and retrieving MailItems, creating and onboarding Locations (including USPS Form 1583 sessions and signature packets), and listing, creating and deactivating Companies. However, the docs say the API 'currently' supports only mail retrieval and Location/Company management. None of the core mail actions (scan, ship, shred, deposit) are shown as API-drivable, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: API endpoints for mail actions (scan/forward/shred/deposit, tagging, routing), a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
